chunks.heading: A 79-Year-Old Legacy Moulding
chunks.text: India's foremost computer networking institute committed to creating a better life for students, franchisees and employees through quality IT education.

chunks.heading: Our Purpose & Values
chunks.text: To Provide Economic Independence To 10 Million People In India And Overseas.

chunks.heading: Our Purpose & Values
chunks.text: To Become A World-class Engine For Employment Generation Through An Efficient Partnership Network.

chunks.heading: Placements
chunks.text: Jetking holds a Limca Book of Records entry for 11,451 students placed in a single year, supported by 12,000+ recruitment partners across the country.

chunks.heading: History
chunks.text: Jetking Electronics was established by the late Shri Gordhandas P Bharwani for trading in electronic goods across India, and was the first to introduce do-it-yourself electronic kits in the country.

chunks.heading: Leadership
chunks.text: Mr. Harsh Bharwani is Managing Director and CEO, with more than 20 years of experience and over a million students trained in employability and personal development.

chunks.heading: Recognition
chunks.text: Jetking Infotrain has been recognised as the largest Red Hat training partner in India and is Great Place to Work certified.

chunks.heading: Cyber security
chunks.text: Cyber security programmes cover penetration testing, vulnerability assessment and security frameworks, and are delivered in offline and hybrid modes across 100+ centres.

chunks.heading: Reach us
chunks.text: Jetking centres operate in more than 30 Indian cities, with international centres in Vietnam, Nepal and Ghana. Call the helpline or email to find the nearest centre.

courses.name: BCA In Cloud Computing & Cyber Security
courses.summary: A UGC-approved three-year graduation degree combining cloud computing and cyber security with hands-on labs.
courses.eligibility: Pass in 10+2 from any recognised board (State / CBSE / ICSE).
outcomes: Enter roles such as Cloud Administrator, SOC Analyst or Network Security Specialist

courses.name: Jetking Certified Cloud Computing & Cyber Security Engineer
courses.summary: An 18-month engineer track covering cloud infrastructure and security operations end to end.
courses.eligibility: Any graduate or 10+2 student aiming for a cloud and security support career.
outcomes: Operate as a Cloud Support, Network Support or Security Support Engineer

courses.name: Ethical Hacking Specialist (CEH)
courses.summary: Penetration testing and vulnerability assessment, aligned to the Certified Ethical Hacker credential.
courses.eligibility: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in cyber security with hardware, networking and OS knowledge.
outcomes: Enter entry-level cyber security and security analyst roles

courses.name: Master In Gaming & Metaverse Design
courses.summary: A two-year programme in game development, 3D design and metaverse experience building.
courses.eligibility: Open to 10+2 students and graduates with a creative interest in gaming and design.
outcomes: Enter roles such as Metaverse Unity Developer, Game Asset Creator or Animator

courses.name: AWS Solution Architect Associate
courses.summary: AWS services and cloud architecture, aligned to the Solutions Architect Associate certification.
courses.eligibility: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in a cloud career.
outcomes: Enter roles such as Cloud Associate (L1) or AWS Cloud NOC Support

courses.name: Data Analytics
courses.summary: Data analysis methodologies and analytics tooling for entry-level analyst roles.
courses.eligibility: Any graduate or 10+2 student interested in data and analytics.

courses.name: MCA In Cloud Computing & Cyber Security
courses.summary: A UGC-approved master's degree in cloud computing and cyber security.
courses.eligibility: BCA, B.Sc. (Computer Science) or any graduation with Mathematics, minimum 50%.
outcomes: Move into Cloud Support Engineer, SOC Analyst or Cybersecurity Analyst roles

faqs.question: Will I get a job after completing the course?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide 100% Job Guarantee upon successful completion of the career course with 80% attendance. The institute includes 120+ hours of soft skills training and holds a Limca Book of Records entry for 11,451 placements.

faqs.question: Are the courses job oriented and as per recruiter requirement?
faqs.answer: The course curriculum in Jetking is tailored and designed according to the recommendation and feedback of the recruiters across various industries, making Jetking a preferred recruitment partner.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to complete all modules?
faqs.answer: All our career programs are divided into modules. It is necessary to complete all modules to get certified, which helps secure placement in reputed companies across sectors.

faqs.question: Are all the Jetking faculties trained and certified?
faqs.answer: All instructors must pass the Faculty Assessment and Certification tests conducted by headquarters. Training of faculties is held every six months in order to upgrade any new technologies.

faqs.question: What are the teaching aids used in Smart Lab Plus?
faqs.answer: The methodology uses 80% exposure to practicals, 20% theory and 100% digitized content. Teaching tools include Mindmap, Window Panes, Simulations and Quiz features.
